lines.en: I'm here for Ross Geller's memorial service.
He's in a really bad mood.
I can't believe that Ross is gone.
I didn't know Ross and you were so close.
But we had one class together.
He was such a great guy.
And he talked so passionately about science.
I'm sure that would mean a lot to him.
And if heaven has a door,
I'm sure he's pressing his ear up against it
I thought so many times about calling him
I guess I really missed my chance.
Corey, I know this is a big surprise for you.
But the things you just said really made my day.
I mean, the fact that you're here means more to me
than if this room were filled with people.
I can't believe I had a crush on you.
Corey Weston had a crush on me!
